```{r}
#| label: setup
source("_eiw-data.R")
library(knitr)

eiw <- eiw_load()
```

::: panel-tabset

```{r}
#| label: req-tabs
#| output: asis
# One tab per requirement category, written by a loop so the tabs follow the
# registry rather than being typed out.
for (cat_name in EIW_CATEGORIES) {

  reqs <- eiw$requirements |>
    filter(category == cat_name) |>
    arrange(req_id)

  if (nrow(reqs) == 0) next

  cat("\n## ", substr(reqs$req_id[1], 1, 2), " — ", cat_name, "\n\n", sep = "")

  tbl <- eiw_tick_matrix(
    links      = eiw$link_uc_req,
    id_col     = "req_id",
    row_ids    = reqs$req_id,
    uc_ids     = eiw$uc_ids,
    status_col = "status"
  ) |>
    left_join(select(reqs, req_id, description), by = "req_id") |>
    mutate(Requirement = paste0("**", req_id, "** ", description)) |>
    relocate(Requirement) |>
    select(-req_id, -description)

  print(kable(tbl, align = c("l", rep("c", length(eiw$uc_ids)))))
  cat("\n")
}
```

:::

## Coverage by category

```{r}
#| label: coverage
# "Use cases covered" counts distinct use cases, separating breadth from depth.
req_counts <- eiw$requirements |>
  count(category, name = "Requirements")

link_counts <- eiw$link_uc_req |>
  left_join(select(eiw$requirements, req_id, category), by = "req_id") |>
  group_by(category) |>
  summarise(
    `Use case links`    = n(),
    `Use cases covered` = n_distinct(uc_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

req_counts |>
  left_join(link_counts, by = "category") |>
  arrange(category) |>
  rename(Category = category) |>
  kable()
```
